services.name: Turtle Reef Morning Snorkel Cruise
services.desc: Dolphins, snorkeling, sights, and great food! Duration 5.5 Hours Check-in is 30 minutes prior to departure. About the Experience Dolphins & Snorkeling The nearshore waters of Lanai are home to sheer cliffs, craggy rocks, and coral reefs full of colorful marine life. A large pod of spinner dolphins lives offshore and spends a considerable amount of time in the channel. It is very common for our guests to witness these incredible marine mammals diving, leaping, and swimming powerfully alongside the boat! Because the island is not as developed as Maui, Oahu, or Kauai, and the human population is small, the corals and other reef life have more space and time to thrive. You will love exploring

services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: Maui Whale Watch Cruise
services.desc: Experience the awe-inspiring behaviors of the Humpback whales on this incredible whale watching adventure Come the Quicksilver a power catamaran with two decks each providing excellent vantage points for viewing the Humpback whales. Whether you are seated outside on the upper deck or inside the shaded cabin all feel like front row seats. Our Captain will provide an expert narrative of the Humpback whale's historical significance in Maui waters and "play-play" commentary of the incredible whale behaviors as you view them. Have your cameras ready to capture these majestic creatures blowing huge sprays into the air, slapping their fins and tails, spy hopping, and the awe-inspiring breach. This

services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor: Sunset Dinner Cruise Aboard the Quicksilver
services.desc: An unforgettable Maui dining experience you do not want to miss. Sip on cocktails and take in the world-famous Maui sunset as our attentive crew serves you a delicious three-course meal table-side. Come aboard the Quicksilver and leave the crowded restaurants behind. This spacious double-deck catamaran offers comfortable seating with generous table spacing for a more private intimate setting. Whether you are seated outside on the upper deck or inside the shaded cabin below all provide excellent vantage points to enjoy the beautiful Maui scenery. Add island style music and the Aloha of the friendly crew to top off the ambiance of this unique Maui experience. Duration 2 hours Dinner served

services.name: From Maalaea: 4th of July Fireworks, Pupu's, and Cocktail Cruise
services.desc: Watch 4th of July Fireworks, Eat Delicious Pupu's, and Enjoy Cocktails Aboard the Quicksilver!!! About the Experience Come enjoy the 4th of July celebration aboard the spacious and comfortable Quicksilver. Board the Quicksilver and grab a seat on the upper or lower deck. Sit back, relax, listen to music, snack on delicious pupu's, and order a beer, glass of wine, or cocktail. We will cruise to watch the fireworks and once the show is over head back to the harbor. Duration 2.0 Hours Estimated (Duration dependent on the start time and duration of the fireworks show) Meet At Boss Frog's Ma'alaea Harbor, 300 Ma'alaea Road, Building 2, Shop# 2N, Wailuku, HI 96793 Park At Maui Harbor Shops/ Maui
